metadata.title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Readers

metadata.description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It contains the current German R823 LaTeX source control; cumulative English, Spanish, French, and Interslavic working readers; bounded components in additional languages; and editable source, provenance, repair, render, and audit material.

Current bounded additions: complete Paper 37 working translations in zh-Hans-CN and controlled-generic, nonlocalized zh-Hant; Korean Paper 29 U03 for source lines 41-45; exact editable TeX/PDF; machine-readable structural and difficulty controls; and rights-aware visual evidence. U03 is an incomplete proof unit and continues at line 47 after blank line 46.

Chinese Paper 37: both four-page targets are exact producer bytes. The source package includes a 48-unit local index, 85 filtered shared structural records covering theorem/definition/display/footnote units, typed terminology and adverse evidence, five Paper-37 difficulty records, build and parity controls, and an independent archive rebuild receipt. The inherited cumulative Chinese reader remains preserved as a comparison witness.

Korean Paper 29 U03: the one-page target covers only lines 41-45 and supplements, rather than supersedes, U01 and U02. It includes 16 structural records and eight append-only difficulty records. It does not complete Paper 29 or its proof.

Visual evidence: the Paper-37 visual package publishes eight project-generated target-reader pages. Five German control renders are represented by hashes, dimensions, density, page, parent-PDF hash, structural links, and QA dispositions only. The U03 visual package publishes three project-generated renders and records three rights-blocked source JPEGs plus one documented loss event without redistributing those JPEGs. No source-scan JPEG is uploaded in this update.

Status caveat: these are substantial machine-assisted working editions, translations, source controls, and review artifacts. Bounded source-audit claims apply only to their stated units. They are not official critical editions, peer review, proof certification, independent human scholarly review, native-language/community certification, Singapore validation, Taiwan/Hong Kong/Macao localization, accessibility certification, rights determinations, or guarantees that every symbol and translation choice is correct.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

additional_descriptions.description: Reader-first multilingual Noether working corpus. This version adds complete bounded Chinese Paper 37 targets in zh-Hans-CN and controlled generic zh-Hant, plus Korean Paper 29 U03 for source lines 41-45. U03 is an incomplete proof unit continuing at line 47; it supplements U01-U02 and does not complete Paper 29. Visual evidence publishes eleven project-generated renders in total while retaining five Paper-37 German control renders and three U03 source JPEGs as metadata only where rights are not asserted. Not a critical edition, native-language certificate, peer review, proof check, rights determination, or whole-corpus guarantee.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
